summary: Extruding a whole face of a body and joining the prism back must fuse along the edges the two share (#2040). A 20 x 10 x 5 block's top face is swept 3 up (the runner's sweep_face: the prism of that face's own loops) and joined to the block: one solid of 20 x 10 x 8. The fix's test of a face rounded by fillets uses SolidCraft's own face-prism code and is not ported.

cases.name: top_face_prism_joined
cases.note: The block's top face (z = 5) swept 3 along +z, then union(block, prism).
